analysis.coverage_note: Freeze the exact mapping-file checksum before scoring; the existing five-process functional panel is not exhaustive model coverage.
analysis.interpretation: Expression-knockout model evidence in one environment, not laboratory viability, physical DNA shortening, global minimality or proof of retrieval benefit.
analysis.primary_contrast: No-retrieval agent versus greedy-block baseline: successful-run proportion and additional functional deletions, reported jointly. Other method and retrieval contrasts are secondary.
secondary: Endpoint and failure counts for all five methods
Best feasible additional deletions at 25/50/100 attempted candidates, completed counts explicit
Feasible proposal rate, not whole-cell viability
Per-run and per-success cost and runtime; undefined cost per success when none succeeds
analysis.statistics: Show every run, effect sizes and uncertainty; report binary endpoint intervals and exact comparisons where appropriate. Holm-adjust the declared family of secondary pairwise contrasts. Never treat genes, cells or simulation seeds as independent searches. Five runs per method is exploratory for modest differences; no significance-driven seed additions or stopping.
analysis.unit: Independent search run; simulation seeds repeat its nominated genotype.
analysis.validation_rate_limit: Only one finalist per run is validated. Do not infer viability of intermediate candidates or draw unmeasured whole-cell success-versus-evaluation curves.

baseline_policy.eligible_genes: All undeleted genes in the same registry; essential annotations are not silently excluded.

budget_proposal.price_status: Historical planning estimate only. Refresh prices and obtain new approval before launch.

execution.deadline_policy: Freeze absolute study/job deadlines before dispatch. Resumes cannot reset budgets or deadlines.

launch_requirements: New study-specific approval for current costs, scoped model keys, any credential transfer and scheduled monitoring.
Freeze provider route, exact deployed source, dependencies and functional-panel mapping checksum.
Restore and verify archived scientific inputs and the unchanged pre-search dossier on remote Linux.
Integrate terminal-report export into the remote runners; test partial failures, duplicates, candidate limits and resumes end to end.
Enforce literature cutoff on both retrieval paths, archive exact responses and verify isolated memories.
Remote launcher must enforce exclusive locks, concurrency, non-resetting model-key caps, absolute deadlines and verified checkpoints.
Test backup failure and bounded recovery on the frozen Linux deployment before paid search calls.
Freeze and verify all terminal nominations before validation; no finalist replacement or new scientific repairs.

literature.cost_accounting: Report original dossier-generation cost separately and amortized across its users; unknown historical cost remains unknown. Adaptive retrieval/model costs count against each run.
literature.information_boundary: Both literature arms receive the same immutable pre-search dossier. No prior search plans, outcomes or validation feedback. No-retrieval retains ordinary annotations and scientific tools.
literature.retrieval_reproducibility: Enforce the cutoff on search and full-text fetch. Archive exact queries, responses, timestamps and citation IDs. Date filtering does not freeze a changing index; replay archived responses for exact audit.

question: How reliably do five search policies find further-reduced genomes that sustain the held-out 20-generation whole-cell endpoint under a common candidate budget?
replication: Five independent fresh sessions per method, in five blocks with reproducibly randomized method order. Seed controls policy ordering, not guaranteed model API determinism. Historical experiments remain exploratory evidence.

reproducibility.git: Protocol, methods, source identities and compact summaries; no bulk data or credentials.
reproducibility.ledger: Preparation is cataloged separately from verified historical results. Record approvals, worker, absolute deadlines, protocol/runtime/input hashes at launch; add exact verified S3/W&B references after uploads.
reproducibility.report_contract: One terminal run-report.json per planned run, with ordered candidate/evaluator records, costs and failure reason. report-verification.json binds report/protocol hashes to verified S3 and W&B copies.
reproducibility.s3_wandb: Closed-data snapshots/read-only SQLite backup, content-addressed archives, full S3 GET and W&B download verification before cleanup. Preserve every attempt; source stays code, not scientific data.

search.budget_definition: At most 100 distinct new candidate genotypes, excluding the common root. Complete failed screens consume slots. Interrupted evaluations consume attempted slots and remain incomplete; never replace them silently or call 100 attempts 100 completed evaluations.
search.early_stop: Keep every run and its best fully evaluated feasible improvement, including model-cap, deadline and failed runs. No replacement seeds or extra funding. Missing checkpoints remain missing. The compound-stop endpoint and the 100-complete-evaluations analysis are distinct.
search.proposal_accounting: Record proposed, duplicate, malformed, rejected and skipped proposals separately; model spend and time continue to count.

validation.calibration: Two-generation MG1655 control, finite outputs and <=4 GiB peak RSS before batch dispatch.
validation.controls_policy: Controls must pass in the same runtime/batch. Control failure makes the batch inconclusive pending operational diagnosis, not evidence of candidate nonviability.
validation.deduplication: Validate identical genotypes once per runtime/batch and map to every originating search. Shared trajectories are not independent observations.
validation.numerical_policy: Use the existing strict v2 numerical patch uniformly. Unchanged LP/objective/constraints/tolerances; accept fallback only with identical LP, GLP_OPT and finite KKT relative residuals <=1e-7; latch failure against outer retries. Record every assisted cell.
validation.primary_endpoint: A further-reduced nominated genome reaches 20 generations in all three seeds with exact-knockout, finite-output and numerical-policy checks. Denominator includes all five assigned searches per method.
